p.instruction: Put these sentences from The Place of Grace (sentences 6–11) in the order printed.
shuffled: Hence, in place of the Old Testament law and its penalty, Christians are under the law of grace through Christ (Romans 6:14; Galatians 3:10-14, 22-28).
This is why it is an aberration for anyone who is genuinely born-again to habitually and deliberately practice sin (1John 3:8-9).
By grace, we can do what is pleasing and acceptable to God (Ephesians 2:7-10).
In this dispensation of grace, God’s commandments remain sacred and to be obedient is to love God (1 John 5:3).
This is because “whosoever shall keep the whole law, and yet offend in one point, is guilty of all” (James 2:9-12).
However, any attempt to obey the commandment through the Old Testament Law will take away the liberty of the believer (Romans 8:1-3).
